description: Get the instructions for writing in one voice with your own model, for one format, length, platform, intensity and edge. The packet carries the full VOICE.md, an exact length target fitted to the platform's limit, and the rules that keep the user's own facts and identity. It opens with a line that replaces any earlier voice, so switching voices mid-conversation is one call.

edge.description: clean removes swearing, sexual and drug references; full keeps the voice's edge, never slurs or racism.

format.description: post (one standalone post), reply (answers the post being replied to), explanation (connected prose) or thread (several posts).

intensity.description: light lets the user's own phrasing show; full writes completely in the voice.

length.description: one-liner, short, standard or long; each maps to a measured range for the format.

platform.description: Where the draft will be posted: fits its character limit and whether it takes markdown.

voice.description: A voice slug such as elon-musk for the current edition, or an exact voice ID (slug@sha256:…) from search_voices.

name: get_voice_packet

instructions.description: Give these to your model with the user's brief, draft or the post they are replying to.

notice.description: What the profile is, and how writing made with it may be presented.

target.description: The exact length the instructions ask for.

limit.description: The platform's character limit per post, if it has one.

voice_id.description: The voice's slug and edition digest, such as elon-musk@sha256:…; it pins one exact edition.

release_id.description: The Provenry release every voice in this answer was read from.

title: Get a voice packet
